english_draft:
Samsung Electronics announced second-quarter 2026 results on July 30, 2026. No preview from our side existed. Therefore, this analysis does not compare with a prior forecast.

Consolidated revenue was KRW 171.5 trillion. This was an all-time high. Revenue increased 28 percent quarter over quarter. Operating profit was KRW 89.5 trillion. This was also an all-time high. Earnings per share were KRW 10,849 for common and preferred shares. EPS increased 52 percent. The release does not state the comparison base.

Device Solutions division reported revenue of KRW 127.5 trillion and operating profit of KRW 89.2 trillion. Sales increased 56 percent quarter over quarter. The Memory Business achieved record revenue and operating profit. Main drivers were AI server demand, constrained capacity, and rising industry prices. Server revenue reached a record share of the sales mix. HBM4 sales scaled up. The company shipped the industry's first HBM4E samples. System LSI faced flagship seasonality and weak Chinese mobile demand. It held quarterly revenue through volume mobile SoCs and image sensors. First-half revenue reached a record. Foundry improved significantly before incentive-related provisions. HBM base-die demand and US customer orders helped. Design wins expanded, including 2nm HPC.

DX division sales decreased 9 percent quarter over quarter. MX and Networks revenue was KRW 33.2 trillion. Operating loss was KRW 0.7 trillion. Component cost pressure reduced earnings. SDC revenue was KRW 7.5 trillion. Operating profit was KRW 0.7 trillion. High-end OLED and gaming monitors supported earnings. VD and DA revenue was KRW 14.5 trillion. The businesses posted a slight operating loss. Sports events boosted VD revenue, but costs hurt profit. Harman improved earnings on expanded automotive and audio sales.

Using the official numbers, non-DS divisions contributed roughly KRW 0.3 trillion of operating profit. This is our calculation. The simple sum of announced divisional revenue exceeds consolidated revenue by KRW 11.2 trillion. The release does not explain this difference. We do not aggregate divisional revenue.

For the second half of 2026, the company guides memory market undersupply, strong AI server demand, Foundry double-digit revenue growth, and new product ramps. Next quarter focus: memory pricing and HBM ramp, Foundry profitability, MX margin, and SDC OLED line ramp.
reader_questions: 每股收益的52%增幅，是与上年同期还是与上季度相比？新闻稿未说明，阅读时是否应避免推断？
合并营业利润89.5万亿，而DS营业利润89.2万亿，非DS部门合计仅0.3万亿；但官方还披露SDC盈利0.7万亿、MX亏损0.7万亿、CE轻微亏损、Harman盈利，这些数字与0.3万亿如何 reconcile？
Foundry“在激励相关拨备之前”盈利显著改善，那么计入拨备后的实际盈利表现如何？是否影响对DS盈利质量的判断？
fact_checks:
第一轮核实：
- 发布与季度：官方新闻稿日期2026-07-30，覆盖截至2026-06-30季度，与任务指定一致。
- 币种单位：所有重大金额为万亿韩元；EPS为韩元。
- GAAP/非GAAP：新闻稿未提，本稿不假设口径；官方未使用“非GAAP”等字样。
- 集团/分部：合并收入171.5，DS 127.5，SDC 7.5，MX 33.2，VD+DA 14.5；分部加总182.7，差异11.2，官方未解释，本稿不将加总视为合并口径。
- 实际 vs 指引：新闻稿区分了Q2实际业绩和H2展望（公司指引）；本稿将“下一季关注”标注为指引/观察点。
- 本稿推论：根据官方环比+28%，合并营收上季约134.0万亿（171.5/1.28）；根据合并营业利润与DS差额，非DS营业利润约0.3万亿。以上均为本稿计算，非官方披露。
- 关于EPS 52%：新闻稿未指明同比或环比，本稿在markdown中仅写“增长52%”，未附加比较基准。

第二轮互检：
- 扮演新读者提问三个问题（见reader_questions），据此修改正文：明确EPS基期未披露；提示分部加总差异；区分Foundry拨备前/后。检查结论与证据一致，未发现与官方新闻稿冲突或编造。
